del.sectionText: Erases the employee and all their records for good. To pause someone, use Deactivate instead.
del.title: Delete {name} permanently
del.warnTitle: This cannot be undone from the app
del.warn: Everything will be erased for good: attendance, corrections, points, leave, requests, deductions, rewards, payroll, payslips, recorded payments and sign-in codes. Historical totals may change and old reports cannot be reproduced. Deleting does not return any money or reverse a transfer made outside the app.
del.warnEn: This permanently erases this employee's attendance, points, leave, requests, deductions, rewards, payroll, payslips, recorded payments and sign-in codes. Historical totals may change and old reports cannot be reproduced. It cannot be undone from the app and does not reverse any real payment.
del.backups: Copies already downloaded, printed or sent cannot be erased by the app. Backups at the hosting provider expire on the provider's schedule, not immediately.
del.shared: Shared reports (daily/weekly summaries, saved Telegram reports) drop this employee or are withdrawn; no other employee's data or company settings are touched.
del.typeName: To confirm, type the employee's name exactly: {name}
del.finalText: Press “Delete permanently now” to erase {name} and all their records. There is no way back.
del.done: The employee and all their records were deleted permanently.
del.incompleteText: The data is erased and access is blocked, but the sign-in account itself is not deleted yet. Retry from Employees.
del.changed: Their records changed since the preview. Review the new counts and confirm again.
err.confirm_name_mismatch: The typed name doesn't match the employee.
